verdict: finite-family theorem passes the independent mathematical audit; dimension-free capacity-only implication remains open

claims.statement: For the singleton HJW measurement F on the Choi reference, the Brandao-Harrow chain proof's final mutual information is bounded by I(X:B^K), equal to the Holevo information of the broadcaster outputs and at most the input family capacity C.
claims.scope: finite-dimensional permutation-invariant K-output channel extension; every finite prior

claims.statement: The conditional-product separable candidates in the BH chain proof average back to the original R:B marginal, so sigma_R=bar(rho)^T; they also preserve sigma_B. Restricting the infimum to the fixed reference marginal is valid.
claims.scope: candidate sigma at each chain step, not a universal explicit optimizer

claims.statement: The fixed receiver POVM {Q_{j,z}/N} yields average half-trace EB loss at most N epsilon/2; compact-convex minimax then gives one full-domain EB channel with the same worst-family bound.
claims.limitation: the factor N is not removed by minimax

claims.statement: A separable sigma with sigma_R=bar(rho)^T inverts to a measure-and-prepare channel TP on supp(bar(rho)); adding a complementary effect completes it to a full-domain EB CPTP map. Positive-prior states lie in that support.
claims.scope: zero-prior states are handled by the later minimax argument, not this individual prior's Bayes optimizer

claims.statement: The family rho_P=(I+aP)/d over signed nonidentity Hermitian Paulis, with I/d, has Holevo capacity at most c(a), pairwise half-trace separation at least a/2, exact EB error a/2*(1-1/(d+1)), and exact optimal two-output broadcast error a*d/(4(d+1)).
claims.limitation: broadcast error tends a/4, so this is not a vanishing-broadcast-error counterexample

claims.statement: No dimension-free capacity-only replacement for the N factor was established. A stronger route must exploit the broadcast constraint to control simultaneous, label-dependent Helstrom tests; cardinality, packing, and raw incompatibility counts are insufficient.
